statusLine.command: input=$(cat); win=$(jq -r '.autoCompactWindow // empty' ~/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // 0'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r --arg win "$win" '.context_window as $c | ($c.current_usage // empty) as $u | ([($win | tonumber? // $c.context_window_size), $c.context_window_size] | min) as $w | ((($u.input_tokens + $u.cache_creation_input_tokens + $u.cache_read_input_tokens) * 100 / $w + 0.5 | floor | tostring) + "%")'); printf 'Cost: $%.2f | Context used: %s' "$cost" "${ctx:---}"

hooks.statusMessage: Checking the commit for env files
